title: Juicy Sweet Egyptian Date Pudding
description: A resinous and bouncy Egyptian dessert featuring demerara sugar, perfect for midnight cravings. This dish is nut-free and served in a lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, puree the egyptian dates with 1 cup of full fat milk until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the demerara sugar, cornstarch, and melted unsalted butter.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the large eggs and vanilla extract.
Add the egg mixture to the sugar mixture and whisk until well combined.
Add the date puree to the sugar mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a lacquerware bowl and place it in a bain-marie.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours before serving.
